title: Bazaar Meat Opens at Andaz Miami Beach
igCaption:
Bazaar Meat Miami Beach opens October 22 at Andaz Miami Beach.
José Andrés has won several James Beard Awards and founded World Central Kitchen.
Would you try for a reservation here?

Sources: Haute Living, WhatNow, Miami New Times, Observer, Wikipedia José Andrés, Wikipedia Hyatt, Wikipedia Miami Beach

#MiamiBeach #BazaarMeat #JoseAndres #SouthFloridaFood

scenes.text: José Andrés is opening Bazaar Meat at Andaz Miami Beach on October twenty-second.
Bazaar Meat Miami Beach opens October twenty-second at Andaz Miami Beach.
scenes.caption: Bazaar Meat Miami Beach opens Oct. 22 at Andaz Miami Beach.

scenes.text: José Andrés was born in Spain on July thirteenth, nineteen sixty-nine. He moved to the United States in the early nineteen nineties, and in nineteen ninety-three he led the kitchen at Jaleo in Washington, D.C.
scenes.caption: José Andrés was born in Spain on July 13, 1969. He moved to the United States in the early 1990s, and in 1993 he led the kitchen at Jaleo in Washington, D.C.

scenes.text: Andrés founded World Central Kitchen, a nonprofit that provides meals after natural disasters. The organization took in five hundred nineteen million dollars in grants and donations in twenty twenty-two.
scenes.caption: Andrés founded World Central Kitchen, a nonprofit that provides meals after natural disasters. The organization took in $519 million in grants and donations in 2022.

scenes.text: Andaz launched in April two thousand seven. Hyatt has more than one thousand three hundred fifty hotels and all-inclusive properties in sixty-nine countries.
scenes.caption: Andaz launched in April 2007. Hyatt has more than 1,350 hotels and all-inclusive properties in 69 countries.

scenes.text: Would you try to get a table here on opening week? Opening week is the kind of night you spot the same face in line, never catch their name, and NEAR shows you who that was.
